properties.displayName: AI Hub: subscription Disabled longer than 5 days
properties.description: Pages the platform team when this subscription has been in Disabled state for more than 5 days. Protects against the 90 day permanent delete window if the Enable workflow fails silently.

allOf.query: AzureActivity | where SubscriptionId == '${SUBSCRIPTION_ID}' | where TimeGenerated > ago(10d) | where OperationNameValue in~ ('Microsoft.Subscription/cancel/action', 'Microsoft.Subscription/enable/action') | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SubscriptionId | where OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.Subscription/cancel/action' | where now() - TimeGenerated > 5d | summarize Count = count()
